why: Pre-deploy rollback state for the customer_auth fix. customer_auth.py lives in the shared layer, so all three consumers must be republished and their live aliases moved; the fix is not live until then. Root cause: authenticate() required the Cognito attribute custom:customer_id, which is absent from pool us-east-1_46ULYuukt's schema (its only custom attribute is custom:partner_waba_id), so every customer token was refused and no customer could sign in, load the catalogue, or check out.
rollback: Move each live alias back to the FunctionVersion below with aws lambda update-alias. The prior versions are immutable and retained, so this is a pointer move, not a redeploy.
blastRadiusIfRolledBack: Reverting restores the pre-fix behaviour: customer sign-in, catalogue load and checkout all refuse with 401 VERIFICATION_REQUIRED. Safe to do, because every customer-keyed table was measured empty on 2026-10-02 (CustomerSessionsTable, OrderTable, PaymentAttemptsTable, WixOrderIds, WixOrdersCache all 0 items), so no customer identity or order depends on either behaviour.
notRolledBackBy: This file does not cover the frontend commit d171fd10 (WCAG 2.5.3 pill naming), which ships via Amplify and is independent.
